notes: All library reads start at Query.desLibrary and use the Des* schema exposed by Altium 365.
Symbols and footprints are read from their complete DesLibrary collections. Component associations are retained through DesComponentDetails.
Keep migration order: symbols, footprints, components. Components must reference target models and templates only.

symbols.query: query ListDesSymbols($first: Int!, $after: String) { desLibrary { symbols(first: $first, after: $after, where: { name: { startsWith: "SYM-" } }) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id guid name description comment itemInternalId revisionInternalId imageThumbnailUrl createdAt releasedAt folder { id folderId name path } lifeCycleState { lifeCycleStateId name } } } } }

footprints.query: query ListDesFootprints($first: Int!, $after: String) { desLibrary { footprints(first: $first, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id guid name description comment itemInternalId revisionInternalId imageThumbnailUrl createdAt releasedAt folder { id folderId name path } lifeCycleState { lifeCycleStateId name } } } } }

components.query: query ListDesComponents($first: Int!, $after: String) { desLibrary(args: { allComponentRevisions: true }) { components(first: $first, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id revisionId name description comment isManaged createdAt modifiedAt folder { id folderId name path } revision { revisionId details { revisionId releaseDate modifiedAt lifeCycleState { lifeCycleStateId name } } } componentType { componentTypeId name path } componentTemplate { id name description comment createdAt downloadableFile { fileName relativePath downloadUrl } } } } } }

componentDetails.query: query GetDesComponentDetails($id: ID!) { desComponentById(id: $id) { id revisionId name description comment manufacturerParts { companyName partNumber priority octopartId } folder { id folderId name path } revision { revisionId details { revisionId releaseDate modifiedAt lifeCycleState { lifeCycleStateId name } } } details { parameters { name value realValue type } itemParameters { name value realValue type } symbols { id guid name description comment itemInternalId revisionInternalId dataDownloadUrl folder { id folderId name path } } footprints { id guid name description comment itemInternalId revisionInternalId dataDownloadUrl folder { id folderId name path } } } } }

symbolDetails.query: query GetDesSymbolDetails($id: ID!) { desSymbolById(id: $id) { id guid name description comment itemInternalId revisionInternalId imageThumbnailUrl dataDownloadUrl folder { id folderId name path } lifeCycleState { lifeCycleStateId name } } }

footprintDetails.query: query GetDesFootprintDetails($id: ID!) { desFootprintById(id: $id) { id guid name description comment itemInternalId revisionInternalId imageThumbnailUrl dataDownloadUrl folder { id folderId name path } lifeCycleState { lifeCycleStateId name } } }

findTargetSymbol.query: query FindTargetDesSymbol($name: String!) { desLibrary { symbols(first: 50, where: { name: { startsWith: $name } }) { nodes { id name comment description itemInternalId revisionInternalId releasedAt lifeCycleState { name } folder { id folderId name path } } } } }

findTargetFootprint.query: query FindTargetDesFootprint($name: String!) { desLibrary { footprints(first: 50, where: { name: { startsWith: $name } }) { nodes { id name comment description itemInternalId revisionInternalId releasedAt lifeCycleState { name } folder { id folderId name path } } } } }

folders.query: query ListDesFolders { desLibrary { folders { id folderId name path folderType itemNamingSchemeTemplate parent { id folderId name path itemNamingSchemeTemplate parent { id folderId name path itemNamingSchemeTemplate parent { id folderId name path itemNamingSchemeTemplate } } } } } }

projects.query: query ListProjectsForMigration($first: Int!, $after: String) { desProjects(first: $first, after: $after, order: [{ updatedAt: DESC }]) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id projectId name description projectType repositoryType repositoryUrl url createdAt updatedAt latestRevision { revisionId author createdAt message } revisions(first: 1) { totalCount } design { releases(first: 1) { totalCount } } } } }

projectDetails.query: query GetProjectMigrationDetails($id: ID!) { desProjectById(id: $id) { id projectId name description projectType repositoryType repositoryUrl url createdAt updatedAt latestRevision { revisionId author createdAt message } revisions(first: 1) { totalCount } design { releases(first: 1) { totalCount } } } }

componentTemplates.query: query ListDesComponentTemplates($first: Int!, $after: String) { desLibrary { componentTemplates(first: $first, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name description folder { id folderId name path } latestRevision { id name description comment createdAt downloadableFile { fileName relativePath downloadUrl } } } } } }

componentParameterValues.query: query ListTargetComponentParameterValues($first: Int!, $after: String) { desLibrary { components(first: $first, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name componentTemplate { id name } details { parameters { name value realValue type } } } } } }

targetComponentModels.query: query ListTargetComponentModels($first: Int!, $after: String) { desLibrary { components(first: $first, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name details { symbols { id name description comment revisionInternalId folder { id folderId name path } } footprints { id name description comment revisionInternalId folder { id folderId name path } } } } } } }

findTargetComponent.query: query FindTargetDesComponent($name: String!) { desLibrary(args: { allComponentRevisions: true }) { components(first: 50, where: { name: { eq: $name } }) { nodes { id revisionId name modifiedAt folder { id folderId name path } revision { details { releaseDate modifiedAt lifeCycleState { name } } } } } } }

findTargetComponentsByPrefix.query: query FindTargetDesComponentsByPrefix($first: Int!, $after: String) { desLibrary(args: { allComponentRevisions: true }) { components(first: $first, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id revisionId name createdAt modifiedAt comment folder { id folderId name path } revision { details { releaseDate modifiedAt lifeCycleState { name } } } } } } }

findTargetComponentsByComment.query: query FindTargetDesComponentsByComment($comment: String!) { desLibrary(args: { allComponentRevisions: true }) { components(first: 50, where: { comment: { eq: $comment } }) { nodes { id revisionId name createdAt modifiedAt comment folder { id folderId name path } revision { details { releaseDate modifiedAt lifeCycleState { name } } } } } } }

createSymbol.query: mutation CreateDesSymbol($input: DesCreateSymbolInput!) { desCreateSymbol(input: $input) { id errors { message } } }

createFootprint.query: mutation CreateDesFootprint($input: DesCreateFootprintInput!) { desCreateFootprint(input: $input) { footprintId errors { message } } }

createComponent.query: mutation ReleaseDesComponent($input: DesReleaseComponentInput!) { desReleaseComponent(input: $input) { errors { message } } }

addComponentPartChoices.query: mutation AddDesComponentPartChoices($input: DesAddComponentPartChoicesInput!) { desAddComponentPartChoices(input: $input) { componentId errors { message } } }
